ext_description.message: Automatically deletes third-party cookies when you close the last tab of a website. Keeps cookies of any site you still have open.

popup_hint.message: Cleans third-party cookies when you close the last tab of a site.

options_subtitle.message: Clean third-party cookies automatically, only after you close the last tab of a site.

options_enable_desc.message: When enabled, third-party cookies are removed after you close the last tab of a website.

options_notify_desc.message: Display a brief notification with how many cookies were removed.

options_about_body.message: When you close the last tab of a website, Cookie AutoClean removes third-party cookies from your browser, while keeping cookies of any site you still have open.
